import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set up the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create a 2x2 subplot layout for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
palette = {"setosa": "#FF6B6B", "versicolor": "#4ECDC4", "virginica": "#45B7D1"}

# Plot 1: Petal Length vs Petal Width (most discriminative features)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=100, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10)

# Plot 2: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=100, alpha=0.7, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10)

# Plot 3: Box plots for all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            palette=palette, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)
ax3.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Violin plot for petal length (most discriminative single feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax4)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', color='black', 
              alpha=0.3, size=4, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Flower Species Classification Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
